name: dr-coral-side
js: const g=window.__game; g.stage({boat:{id:'coral',x:300,z:-1800,h:0}, simulate:2}); const b=g.boat.pos; const L=g.boat.def.length; g.photo={pos:[b.x+L*0.9+3, 2.2+L*0.12, b.z+L*0.15], look:[b.x,1.0,b.z], fov:50};
